name: Document OCR
description: Extract structured data from documents using Optical Character Recognition (OCR) services.
project_description: Document OCR is a framework for extracting text and structured data from uploaded documents, images and audio, then mapping that data into fields of Drupal content or config entities. It defines two annotation-based plugin types: OCR processor plugins (which read a file and return properties/text) and property transformer plugins (which post-process a property value before it is written to a field). Ships six processors (Google Document AI, Tesseract OCR, PDFtoText/Poppler, PDF parser, Docconv extractor, OpenAI Audio transcription) and eight transformers (Basic, Pipeline, Truncate, Encoding Converter, Google Translate, Microsoft Translate, Google Text to Speech, OpenAI Chat). Three config entities (mapping, processor, transformer) plus two content entities (task, data) store the wiring and results. A visual field-to-property mapping tool builds mappings; documents are processed either in real time on entity save or queued and handled on cron (with an asynchronous mode for Google Document AI large-file jobs via Google Cloud Storage). A one-time import tool lets admins upload files and process them ad hoc. All administration is gated by the single 'administer document ocr' permission under Configuration → Structure → Document OCR.
